items.exampleEn: She always tries to outdo her older sister.
After a long tramp through the woods, we were ready for dinner.
items.exampleZh: 在樹林裡走了好長一段路之後，我們都準備好吃晚餐了。

items.exampleEn: Take a peep at the baby; she's finally asleep.
items.exampleZh: 偷偷看一眼寶寶，她終於睡著了。

items.exampleEn: The hospital has standby power in case the electricity goes out.
items.exampleZh: 醫院有備用電力，以防停電。

items.exampleEn: The duplication of keys without permission is not allowed here.
items.exampleZh: 這裡不允許未經許可複製鑰匙。

items.exampleEn: With hard work, a place at a top university is attainable.
items.exampleZh: 只要努力，進入頂尖大學是可以達到的。

items.exampleEn: We need to repaint the old fence before winter.
items.exampleZh: 我們得在冬天前把舊籬笆重新粉刷。

items.sentenceEn: The tramp from the station to the farm took my grandfather two hours.
items.sentenceZh: 從車站走到農場，花了爺爺兩個小時。

items.audioEn: I only took a quick peep at the exam paper, so I don't know how hard it is.
items.audioZh: 我只匆匆瞄了一眼考卷，所以不知道它有多難。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼不知道考題難不難？
options: Took a long look at the paper
Hasn't seen the paper at all
Only had a short look at it

items.sentenceEn: I bought a standby ticket and waited for an empty seat.
items.sentenceZh: 我買了候補票，等著有空位。

items.sentenceEn: Each year the festival tries to outdo the last one.
items.sentenceZh: 這個節慶每年都想辦得比前一年更好。

items.stemEn: The two chefs keep trying to ____ each other with bigger and better cakes.
items.stemZh: 那兩位廚師一直想用更大更好的蛋糕勝過對方。

items.stemEn: After months of training, finishing the marathon now seems ____.
items.stemZh: 經過幾個月的訓練，跑完馬拉松現在看起來是做得到的。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, twenty volunteers met at the park to repaint the old playground. Thanks to the generosity of a local shop, the paint was free. The leader divided the work clearly to avoid any duplication. We chose a sunny day, because paint dries slowly in damp air. Some children kept coming to take a peep at our work. By evening, the slide and swings looked bright again. Our goal of finishing in one day had seemed hard, but it turned out to be attainable.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，二十位志工在公園集合，要把舊遊樂場重新粉刷一遍。多虧附近一家店慷慨捐贈，油漆是免費的。負責人把工作分得很清楚，避免有人做重複的事。我們選了晴天，因為油漆在潮濕的空氣中乾得比較慢。有些孩子一直跑來偷看我們做事。到了傍晚，溜滑梯和鞦韆又變得色彩鮮豔。原本覺得一天內完成的目標很難，結果卻做到了。

options: 潮濕的空氣會讓油漆乾得慢
週末下雨公園會關門，不能進去

questions.questionZh: 「一天完成」的目標最後怎麼樣？
options: 只完成了一半，下週再來

items.promptZh: 他在比賽中想要勝過去年的冠軍。
referenceEn: He wants to outdo last year's champion in the race.
In the competition, he hopes to outdo last year's winner.
rubricZh: 要用 outdo（例如 outdo last year's champion）
「想要」可寫，例如 wants to、hopes to 等

items.promptZh: 這齣戲有兩位候補演員，需要時隨時可以上台。
referenceEn: The play has two standby actors who are ready to go on stage if needed.
There are two actors on standby for the play, ready to perform when needed.
rubricZh: standby 可放名詞前或寫成 on standby（例如 two standby actors、two actors on standby 等）
「需要時隨時可以上台」可寫，例如 ready to go on stage if needed 等
